zero_match_cross_check.official_calendar_check: MAJOR COVERAGE GAP ON OLBG: the Rugby League World Cup 2026 is being played in Australia/Papua New Guinea/New Zealand from 15 October to 15 November 2026 (Australia beat New Zealand 24-22 in the 15 Oct opener; fixtures continue 23, 24, 25 Oct and beyond), yet OLBG's Rugby League feed listed no individual matches on 21 Oct 2026 - only three long-term outright markets. This dashboard covers OLBG-listed events by definition, so no World Cup matches are originated here; the gap is documented in Findings as a data-quality issue with the source feed (the server-rendered feed we can verify), not filled with unverified events.

outrights.basis: Reigning champions: New South Wales won the 2026 series 2-1, taking the 8 July decider 30-12 at Suncorp Stadium with Nathan Cleary (2 tries, 5/5 goals) winning the Wally Lewis Medal. Title-holder basis.

Reigning champions: Wakefield Trinity won their first Super League title (first league championship since 1968) by beating Warrington Wolves 23-10 in the 2026 Grand Final at Old Trafford on 3 Oct (19-0 up at half-time; Tom Johnstone Rob Burrow Award winner), a week after winning 33-6 at favourites Wigan in the semi-final. Title-holder basis.

Reigning premiers: Sydney Roosters beat Newcastle Knights 19-18 in the 2026 NRL Grand Final at Accor Stadium on 4 Oct (Daly Cherry-Evans' late field goal decisive; James Tedesco Clive Churchill Medal) for their 16th premiership. Title-holder basis.
